questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne bo i en storby med godt vejr, og som ikke var alt for langt væk.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg havde et skønt ophold, hvad angår det sociale. I forhold til det faglige er det vigtigt at være opmærksom på at UPF kører med trimester og ikke semester. Så det var ikke muligt for mig at nå alle mine ects hvilket jeg ikke synes var helt optimalt. Men byen er skøn og der er mange udvekslingsstuderende, hvilket er rigtig fedt.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt, skolen var hjælpsom.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Fik hjælp til ift. hvad jeg skulle gøre med fag og ects point.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte airbnb med en anden veninde som også skulle afsted - airbnb er godt, fordi der ikke er depositum. På mange andre boligsider er der meget højt depositum. Jeg vil anbefale ikke at bo i Born, da vi først havde lejlighed der men måtte skifte til Raval, da der var kakerlakker overalt. Mange af bygningerne i Born er meget gamle, så jeg fik at vide af udlejer, at der generelt er problemer med kakerlakker der.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Start i god tid. Man kan få bedre lejligheder til mere fair priser hvis man er 4+ der bor sammen.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Jeg havde søgt nogle fag inden, og så inden skolestart kunne man ændre det under "add and drop" days.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne kontakte skolen og få hjælp på både mail og telefon.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Fik alt jeg ville. Fik også lov til at droppe et fag jeg ikke ønskede alligevel, selvom add and drop days var ovre.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vær opmærksom på at det er trimester, så du kan ikke søge så mange fag som man ellers burde herhjemme.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Synes det faglige var rigtig godt! Har lært utrolig meget.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det er ikke det sværeste niveau til undervisning, men eksamensperioden ligger på 2 uger, så der kan man godt blive lidt presset over at skulle nå det hele.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Et fag måtte vi slet ikke have nogen form for elektronik fremme. I de andre var det meget som herhjemme.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: International criminology, contemporary thought, business ethics and CSR, borders and geopolitics og global cities.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes contemporary thought var det jeg lærte mest i! Det gav et godt billede af hvorfor vores samfund ser ud i dag som det gør.

questions.answer: Transport er meget billigt. Man kan få et spansk slags rejsekort til omkring 40 eur for tre måneder.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg brugte det ikke

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte det ikke

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte det ikke

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag til nogle af de små byer rundt omkring Barcelona!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde kun internationale klassekamerater og venner, så det ved jeg ikke. De lokale var ikke super åbne, men jeg tror at det har noget at gøre med deres turisme-problem.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Desværre ikke.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: At de lokale ikke rigtig kan/vil snakke engelsk. Så det var svært at kommunikere med dem.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At der altid er liv i byen ligemeget om det er mandag eller fredag, sommer eller vinter. Der er altid noget at lave!

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vær opmærksom på trimester struktur, følg godt med i timerne da eksamensperioden er meget kort, og deltag i timerne da det tit tæller en ret stor del af karakteren.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de nye venskaber, at lære en ny kultur at kende og forbedre mit engelsk!

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Sprogbarrierer - de lokale er ikke så gode til engelsk, heller ikke til lægen/på hospitalerne. Sundhedssystemet er også lidt svært at finde ud af, da man hører til en bestemt CAP (lægehus) alt efter ens adresse, så vil anbefale at tage på akutmodtagelsen på hospitalerne hvis man bliver syg dernede.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
